propositions: Bedrock must clear the same non-inferiority bar that was required before the LangGraph→pydantic-ai substrate swap, measured via paired corpus run against direct Anthropic on the same cases.
The corpus pools gold-labeled dataset cases across 15 specs (142 eligible cases total) into a 30-item stratified sample (15 block, 15 advisory) that meets the MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20 floor.
Payload parity and tool parity must be proven by capturing the actual outbound requests at the provider boundary, not by reading code, with both class slots (standard sonnet, frontier opus) measured.
Provider routing must be verified clean via REBAR_USAGE_LOG: the Bedrock arm must make zero calls to non-Bedrock providers across all epochs and case-runs.
